LESSON: ANGLES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade four
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Geometry
Topic 3.2: Angles
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Angles, part of Geometry in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade four MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we use angles in daily life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Discuss in purposive pairs or groups and recognize angles that are made by 2 lines that meet at point using a chart with a different line. Those with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication-aac (residual speech/ digital devices with text- to-speech application/ point/sign/write) during the discussion.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Discuss in purposive pairs or groups and recognize angles that are made by 2 lines that meet at point using a chart with a different line. Those with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication-aac (residual speech/ digital devices with text- to-speech application/ point/sign/write) during the discussion.
2. Team with peers in purposive groups/pairs to explore and identify angles from the objects

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Angles together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: learner collaboratively works with others and recognizes angles that are

made by 2 lines that meet at point using a chart with a different line.

Values:
Responsibility: learner observes safety precautions while identifying angles from objects such as cubes,

cuboids in the environment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Learner explores and identify angles from objects such as cubes, and cuboids in the environment to

enhance environmental education.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate angles from objects such as cubes and cuboids in the environment to perspective in

Creative Arts.
